extensionDescription.message: Open a real tmux terminal in a browser tab.

hostUnreachable.message: foxmux could not reach its native host. Install it from https://github.com/tomoliveri/foxmux/releases/latest (run ./install.sh), then press Enter to retry.

hostOutdated.message: The foxmux native host is out of date. Re-run ./install.sh from https://github.com/tomoliveri/foxmux/releases/latest, then press Enter.

addonOutdated.message: The foxmux native host is newer than this add-on. Update foxmux in about:addons, then press Enter.

tmuxMissing.message: tmux is not installed. Install it (for example with brew install tmux), then press Enter.

protocolError.message: The foxmux native host stopped after a corrupt message. Press Enter to restart it.

optStartDirHelp.message: Where new tmux sessions start. ~ and $$VARS are expanded.

optPerTab.message: New tmux session for each tab (closed with the tab)

optShared.message: Attach every tab to one named session (kept when tabs close)

optFontHelp.message: Icons (eza, starship, powerline…) come from a bundled Nerd Fonts symbols font.

optSaved.message: Saved. Applies to new terminal tabs.
